categories.subtitle: The owners are truly committed to sourcing local. high quality fully traceable ingredients. Our suppliers are as follows: Meat from Redfearns Butchers of Buxton. Vegetables: Tomsons of Buxton, Fish: RG Morris of Buxton, Other Items: Holdsworths of Derbyshire. We profess not to be the cheapest that's because good quality ingredients cost more to produce and to procure. We don't serve unsustainable, untraceable meat that has been reared or slaughtered cruelly nor 'cooked' on mass. Instead we try to serve quality food that is cooked with care. If we wouldn't eat in our own home then it doesn't get served in our pub! Many of our dishes are available gluten free on request (GFA).
